title: Serwis o podatkach - #Twój e-PIT - Podatki.gov.pl
content:
Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - PIT CIT i rozliczenia
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/aktualnosci/twoj-e-pit-od-15-lutego-beda-udostepnione-rozliczenia-pit/
- The page is a portal for tax information on podatki.gov.pl, focusing on the “Twój e-PIT” service.
- It covers various tax areas: personal taxes, business taxes, customs, guides/informational materials, news, tools, and online case handling.
- Key sections for individuals: od dochodu (basic personal income tax and income types), od majątku (taxes related to changes in wealth, including inheritance and donations), od zakupów (taxes on purchases), and other miscellaneous taxes.
- For entrepreneurs: basic taxes for businesses and other taxes (e.g., PCC, SD, mineral extraction taxes, banking-related taxes, alcohol tax, anti-aggressive tax planning clause, business registers for SPVs/ Trusts, crypto activities).
- Additional programs and compliance measures listed: withholding tax (WHT), MDR (tax scheme reporting), ICAP, ETACA, SME procedure, GLOBE, CRBR, etc.
